verdicts.reason: A: the barrel hero photo is shrunk to a thumbnail jammed in the bottom-left corner next to the logo. A distorted dark photo strip floats at the top. The tagline is right-aligned while the headline is centred. Large dead gaps break up the layout, so it reads as scattered fragments. B: it keeps a single centred axis and a sensible headline-then-tagline order, but the hero photo and logo shrink to tiny icons at the bottom, which destroys the brand mark and the imagery. A meaningless dark bar cuts across the middle and the paper texture floats loose. Both are unusable, and B is only marginally more coherent.
